1.consolidated_definition: text. Tejido hecho de fibras especiales obtenidas del estireno y otros productos químicos. Anglicismo adaptado, usual. DRAE 2001, del inglés. Igual pasa con el vestido, los poliesters. Nos estamos preparando para la asfixia colectiva
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Textile made of special fibers obtained from styrene and other chemical products. An adapted Anglicism, commonly used. 

Note: DRAE 2001 refers to the 20th edition of the Real Academia Española dictionary, which is a standard reference for Spanish language.

Also, "asfixia colectiva" translates to collective asphyxiation or suffocation, but in this context, it seems to be used metaphorically to describe a situation of impending crisis or disaster.
